notes: Makes PDF import friendlier on an iPad. The Cooking page now has a paste box next to the Choose-a-PDF button: tap it and paste a recipe you've copied - whether it comes through as the PDF file itself or as text - then press Import pasted recipe. No digging through a file picker. It handles a whole batch too (several recipes pasted at once). Also tidied how imported notes are shown so the source and any note read cleanly on one line.
